perplexity.description:
Alternative Anthems is a 2023 compilation album released by Demon Records, featuring 23 classic tracks from the alternative rock genre. The collection highlights the golden era of American alternative music, bringing together influential songs from prominent artists such as Sonic Youth and other key figures in the movement. Musically, the album spans the diverse sounds of alternative rock, from jangly guitar-driven melodies to raw, experimental textures, reflecting the genre's evolution and enduring impact.

As a compilation, Alternative Anthems does not represent a new release from a single artist but rather serves as a curated retrospective of the genre’s most iconic anthems. It stands as a significant entry in Demon Records’ catalog of genre-focused anthologies, offering both longtime fans and new listeners a comprehensive overview of alternative rock’s defining moments. The album was well-received for its thoughtful track selection and high-quality vinyl presentation, praised for capturing the spirit and energy of a pivotal era in rock history.
